correctness.rationale: At each output atom the MCL equations force either inactivity or a proper finite filter T and a monotone nonconstant w on P(T); the converse verifies all equations. The Det scheme with C=empty forces each singleton in T to win, giving exactly disjunction. Ser removes inactivity and IA follows for all disjoint single-agent coalitions. Independent exhaustive direct equations at n=1,2 return 2/1/2/1 and 49/36/16/9; this is finite corroboration, not an infinite proof.
